subject: Telemetry spike: request for IRP walk-through and SOC 2 evidence escrow
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@finledger.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinLedger SOC2 Team <soc2+audit@finledger.com>, DevOps (FinLedger) <devops@finledger.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry spike on 2026-07-18 — request for IRP and evidence escrow

Hi Naomi,

We observed a short-lived spike in token-generation errors against the prod inference endpoint (approx 02:37–02:45 UTC 2026-07-18) while running routine load tests. No customer data exposure has been identified, but our SOC 2 team needs a short IRP walkthrough and a copy of the incident response plan and supporting artifacts for our upcoming audit window.

Could you: 
- Confirm whether Redwood triggered any automated fallbacks during that window and which model variants served traffic
- Share an IRP (redacted OK) and an initial bundle of telemetry for our team to ingest into our forensic pipeline
- Confirm how long you retain request logs / token-level telemetry and whether a time-limited escrow is possible for audit purposes

We'd like a quick walkthrough call this week if possible. Proposed window: Tue 2026-07-20 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Risk & Compliance Manager
FinLedger

[attachment: telemetry-sample-20260718.json.gz (gzip)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry spike on 2026-07-18 — request for IRP and evidence escrow

Elena —

Thanks for flagging and for the sample telemetry. Short answers up front: 
- We saw the same symptom in our telemetry and automatically routed overflow to the lower-latency pool; no model rollback was necessary.
- I can provide a redacted IRP (see attached IRP_Redacted_v2.pdf) and a focused telemetry export scoped to the window you provided.
- Log retention: standard retention is 90 days for request-level telemetry; we support short-term escrow/extended retention on a per-contract basis — we can propose an escrow window for your audit.

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik to prepare the package and to confirm the call time.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa will assemble the evidence bundle and upload to a shared Drive folder.
2) Karthik will prepare a brief IRP walkthrough deck that covers detection, containment, and communications.
3) We'll confirm the escrow window and a DocuSign SOW addendum if you want extended retention.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance (Customer Programs)
Redwood Inference

[attachment: IRP_Redacted_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finledger.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence bundle — initial upload and call prep

Elena / Naomi / team —

I've uploaded an initial, redacted bundle to the Drive link Naomi shared. Contents: 
- telemetry-sample-20260718.json.gz (sanitized; contains timing + error codes but no customer payload)
- sig-questionnaire-finledger.xlsx (populated where possible; placeholders for items requiring legal sign-off)
- IRP_Redacted_v2.pdf (as Naomi attached)

Action items for our side before the call: 
- Jonas: confirm the exact fallback pool IDs and the small cluster metrics during 02:30–03:00 UTC.
- Karthik: prepare a short slide that maps the IRP steps to the SOC 2 CC6 controls and where we have audit artifacts.

Elena — please confirm whether Tue 2026-07-20 14:00 PT still works; if not, suggest alternatives.

Marissa Cole
Security Operations Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFINLEDGER-evidence]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@finledger.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 07:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence bundle — initial upload and call prep

Quick update — 
- Fallback pools: frankfurt-llm-low-latency-v2 (ID: pool-fra-llm-v2) and burst-pool-1 (ID: bp-1) handled the routed requests; CPU/GPU utilization in those pools peaked at ~74% and there were transient RPC timeouts from one host (host-12) that recovered within 6 minutes.
- No anomalous authentication activity observed.
- I exported the small cluster metrics slice and added it to the Drive folder as metrics-02-37-03-00.csv (redacted hostnames).

I'll be on the Tue call to walk the containment steps.

Jonas Weber
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

[attachment: metrics-02-37-03-00.csv (CSV)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finledger.com>, FinLedger SOC2 Team <soc2+audit@finledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-call summary and postmortem (short) — telemetry spike 2026-07-18

Thanks again for hopping on the call today. Per our discussion, summary and deliverables below: 

Summary: 
- Incident window: 2026-07-18 02:37–02:45 UTC — transient RPC timeouts from host-12 led our smart router to route a fraction of traffic to fallback pools. No model rollbacks or data exfiltration.
- Impact: ~0.6% of requests saw elevated latency or error codes; customer-facing degradations were brief and self-healing.

Deliverables (attached / shared):
1) Redacted IRP (IRP_Redacted_v2.pdf) — contains detection, escalation, containment, and communications playbook.
2) Telemetry export for audit (telemetry-sample-20260718.json.gz) — sanitized, timestamped, redacted payloads.
3) Metrics slice (metrics-02-37-03-00.csv) and short timeline.
4) SIG/CAIQ crosswalk (sig-questionnaire-finledger.xlsx) — entries we can support immediately vs. items needing legal review.

Next steps: 
- Naomi/Marissa: we will provision a time-limited evidence escrow for retention through your audit window (proposed: 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-01) and prepare a short SOW addendum for signature.
- FinLedger: please confirm the escrow dates and any additional artifacts you need (e.g., sample request IDs).

If helpful I can also share an anonymized postmortem writeup suitable for your SOC 2 evidence binder; request accepted and we'll redact customer identifiers.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance (Customer Programs)
Redwood Inference

[attachments: IRP_Redacted_v2.pdf, telemetry-sample-20260718.json.gz, sig-questionnaire-finledger.xlsx]
